shapeSummary: 48mm long aluminum rail-channel, 72mm wide (Y, 0 to 72) and 16mm high (Z). It has a 4mm thin web in the XY plane, with 8mm x 16mm solid rail bars along both long edges. A 14mm through hole sits at the center of the web. Each rail end has a blind 3.3mm axial hole, 8mm deep.
warnings: The web thickness of 4mm and the rail section of 8x16mm are assumed. The real I-shaped profile with paired rails and a running groove is simplified to solid rectangular flanges.
The 14mm center bore diameter is an assumed nominal value.
The small grid holes and slots in the web are omitted because their sizes and positions are not legible.
End holes are placed at z=±4 in the rail centers and are 8mm deep. This differs from the analysis positions at z=±8, which lie outside the 16mm envelope. Hole depth and diameter are assumed.
Overall dimensions other than the 48mm length are scaled estimates.
